command:
git log --oneline -3
npm install --no-save --no-package-lock playwright@1.56.1 >/dev/null 2>&1
python3 -m http.server 8765 --bind 127.0.0.1 >/dev/null 2>&1 &
sleep 1
export CHROMIUM=$(which google-chrome) OUT=/tmp/out; mkdir -p $OUT
for t in activity-state ultra ultra-board composer-fixes harness reasoning; do
  echo "################ $t"
  timeout 280 node tests/web/$t.cjs 2>&1 | cut -c1-700 | grep -E "^(PASS|FAIL|errors|ultra-board)|Error|rror:" | head -60
done

errors.text: timeout 280 node tests/web/$t.cjs 2>&1 | cut -c1-700 | grep -E "^(PASS|FAIL|errors|ultra-board)|Error|rror:" | head -60
